description: Permits are issued only when an Israeli employer files a request with the interior ministry, and only after the worker passes an army security clearance. The permit is written in the employer's name.
energy_note: Your right to work belongs to your boss.

description: Workers may travel only to their designated work area and must return to the West Bank before a set hour or risk arrest. The permit is a movement licence with a curfew attached.
energy_note: A job with a legal bedtime.

description: Because the permit is in the employer's name, raising unpaid wages, unsafe conditions or an injury risks the employer withdrawing the request - which removes the permit, the income and the ability to enter at all.
energy_note: Every labour right, conditional on not using it.

aspect: Security clearance is unexplained and inheritable in practice
description: A refusal is given without reasons, cannot be argued, and frequently attaches to a family rather than an individual.
energy_note: Unemployable because of a file you can't read.

description: Some 100,000 Palestinians had work permits revoked after October 2023, leaving them confined to the West Bank where jobs are scarce and wages far lower. Israel maintains it has no obligation to permit entry for work and decides on security considerations.
energy_note: A hundred thousand livelihoods, ended in a week.
